Copper(II) sulfate is prepared by adding copper(II) oxide to dilute sulfuric acid.
The steps used to obtain copper(II) sulfate crystals are listed.
1
Warm the filtrate until concentrated.
2
Filter the mixture.
3
Heat the mixture and stir.
4
Leave to cool.
What is the correct order of these steps?
A
2 →1 →3 →4
B
1 →2 →4 →3
C
3 →2 →1 →4
D
3 →2 →4 →1
